items: Repository change: VC uvindex travels through the converter, DSF parser and optional cache fields.

cards.title: LifeIndex response (#2599, #2650)
items: KMA getLifeIndexKma adds optional daily UV and oak/pine/weeds grades; pollenGrade is the max available grade and pollenStr its localized label. Daily and current; missing types absent.

Shared mobile templates: pollen risk beside UV; tap the button for an Ionic popup listing available type labels/grades, seasonal explanations and own-grade precautions. Valid zero is Low; no numeric concentration. No pollen means no item.
V3 source: getOakPollenRiskIdxV3 / getPinePollenRiskIdxV3 / getWeedsPollenRiskndxV3. Weather-core retains optional uvIndex and three pollen grades.
